Thanks Ethan — this looks great and congrats to the team on the write-up. Quick notes:

- We can approve logo use for marketing collateral; standard condition is a 12-month visibility window unless you request perpetual rights (that's a legal decision).
- We typically ask for a 48-hour embargo review on press previews so our internal comms can validate quotes and technical claims.
- We require a short evidence packet for the case study (screenshots, scope of pilot) — helps our compliance team.

Looping in Kimberly (Legal) and Connor (Sales Ops) to propose a minimal legal redline and an approval workflow. If Legal prefers, we can do a brand collateral escrow: they upload the final assets to a shared staging bucket and we return a signed permission artifact (saves repeated back-and-forth).

Kimberly / Connor — can you review the attached draft and propose any non-negotiable redlines (especially around testimonial attribution and the "visibility window")? Ethan — what's your ideal timeline for final signoff?

Best,
Hannah
Director, Customer Growth — Redwood Inference

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 14:26:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Draft case study + logo usage — quick sync?

Hi all —

Thanks for the context. We reviewed GreenGrid_case_draft_v1.docx and have the following redline suggestions (high-level):

1) Testimonial attribution — need explicit permission from the quoted individual. Prefer a short attestation paragraph where the signatory confirms the accuracy of the quote and consents to publication.
2) Logo scope — proposed permission: "Non-exclusive license to use Redwood and GreenGrid logos in marketing collateral, digital and print, for a period of 12 months from the date of signed approval, with a single renewal option by mutual written consent."
3) Embargo / review — 48 business-hour review of press preview is reasonable; clarify whether this is calendar days or business days and whether tech claims require engineering sign-off.
4) Confidentiality carveout — ensure the MSA/Order Form includes a narrow public disclosure carveout for jointly-approved case studies; we propose adding an addendum to the Order Form that references the case study and links to the evidence packet.
5) Evidence packet — request: screenshots, usage metrics (aggregated), and a short description of the pilot scope. This remains internal; only summary metrics should be published.

I've attached our annotated redlines (redlines-msa-orderform-gg-0514.pdf). For speed, we can accept a short collateral escrow flow: GreenGrid uploads final assets to a shared folder (we'll provide S3 staging instructions), Legal downloads, signs off and returns a single permission artifact (signed addendum + email confirmation). That avoids repeated DocuSign cycles on minor asset changes.

Please confirm if the 12-month window is acceptable and whether the testimonial signee can sign the attestation. If yes, we'll prepare the addendum and a one-page permission letter for signatures.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redlines-msa-orderform-gg-0514.pdf (annotated redlines)
